name: Firstsight
descriptionSeed: Firstsight — where the shore-road tops the divide and the water finally appears. Twenty-six days out of Longshore through mountain, and then the ground opens and there is the head of the Outrun below you with the sea beyond it, a hundred miles off and unmistakable. There is a cairn, a wayhouse, a smith who shoes for the descent and will not shoe for the climb, and a book where people write the date they first saw it. Nobody founded Firstsight. It is the place where everyone stopped walking for a moment, and eventually someone stayed.
encounterFlavor: keel-hunters heading down for timber they have not seen yet; people coming up from Keelmouth who talk about the sea like a job; the wayhouse keeper, who has read every entry in the book and will tell you about the liars
questSeeds: A name in the wayhouse book is dated four years after the man who wrote it was buried at Keelmouth
The smith will not shoe for the climb and has stopped saying why
